requirement: Where subagents are unavailable, the `habeas-requirements` skill MUST direct agents to review each group themselves against the review prompt of {cite}`requirements.cli.requirements_review_skill.review_prompt`, one group at a time, before presenting any group to the user.
rationale:
The requirement has these obligations. Where subagents are unavailable, the `habeas-requirements` skill must direct agents to (1) review each group themselves, (2) against the review prompt, (3) one group at a time, and (4) before presenting any group to the user.

`tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[the_requirements_skill_reviews_groups_itself_without_subagents]` is marked `{test}` for this requirement and covers all four:
- It calls `step_of` with the phrase "If you can't start subagents, review each group yourself against the prompt, one group at a time". `step_of` panics if no workflow step contains the phrase. `workflow_steps` collapses whitespace and joins continuation lines, so the phrase still matches where it wraps across lines in `SKILL.md`. This checks the unavailable-subagent condition, self-review, the prompt reference and one-at-a-time.
- The prompt reference is not checked separately. The same step (step 3) also names `references/review-prompt.md`, and the test does not assert that link. I treat this as a small residual gap that does not change the verdict, because the sentence follows directly after the subagent instructions that name the prompt.
- It asserts `fallback < step_of(SKILL, "Present each group to the user")`. This is a strict ordering assertion that the fallback step comes before the presentation step. That matches "before presenting any group to the user".

The test would fail if the fallback sentence were removed or reworded, or if it were moved to or after the presentation step. The content of the review prompt belongs to `requirements.cli.requirements_review_skill.review_prompt`, which is cited as context and not reassessed here. I found no acknowledgments and no unmarked gaps.

text: Where subagents are unavailable, the `habeas-requirements` skill MUST direct agents to review each group themselves against the review prompt of {cite}`requirements.cli.requirements_review_skill.review_prompt`, one group at a time, before presenting any group to the user.

The `habeas-requirements` skill MUST supply the review prompt that each group's reviewer follows. The prompt MUST direct the reviewer not to edit files. It MUST direct the reviewer to make mechanical changes itself in the revised text it returns, and to return design questions for the user.
